intro: Picture this: you check into a suite with its own kitchenette and a separate living area, like your own condo; in the evening you walk a few minutes to the seafront park near Ko Loi to catch the Si Racha sea breeze, then come back for a swim in the outdoor pool before bed — Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha is a hotel and serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group set in central Si Racha, Si Racha District, Chonburi province, on Soi Jerm Jompon 1 · what most people talk about is the suites with in-room kitchens and plenty of space, plus a location within walking distance of the seafront downtown and the city's restaurants, which makes it comfortable for both a single night and a long monthly stay · it's a 12-storey tower with rooms from a 43 sqm Studio Suite up to a 148 sqm Two Bedroom Suite, from about THB 1,900/night, scored 9.0 from 67 reviews on Trip.com, with Booking.com scoring it 8.7

body.html: The overview and who it suits — if we boil it right down, Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha is a stay for people who want "a home-like serviced apartment" in central Si Racha, rather than a beachfront holiday resort like the ones in Bang Saen or Pattaya · it's a hotel and serviced apartment in the Cape & Kantary Hotels group, a Thai hotel group with branches across the country, and the building is a 12-storey tower on Soi Jerm Jompon 1 in central Si Racha, Si Racha District, Chonburi province · with a concept where every room is a suite with its own kitchen, suiting both short stays and long monthly ones, the real reviews line up on who fits best here: people coming to work or run errands around Laem Chabang, the industrial estates and the port — engineers, staff at foreign companies, and people posted here long-term — because there's a kitchen to cook your own meals and plenty of living space, just like staying in a condo · another group that says they were impressed is families and couples who want a roomy suite with a kitchen, bringing the kids to the pool and the kids club, along with people travelling to Si Racha on business who want a central stay within walking distance of restaurants and the seafront park · on the flip side, anyone set on sleeping right by the beach with the sea in front of the property may feel this is more of a city tower than a beachfront resort, and should consider stays over in Bang Saen or Pattaya instead · simply put, Kantary Bay plays on "living comfortably, like home, in the middle of town" with the facilities all in place, rather than selling the image of a resort where you can stroll straight down to the water

Location and getting around — this is one of Kantary Bay's biggest selling points, because it sits in central Si Racha on Soi Jerm Jompon 1, a neighbourhood ringed by restaurants, shops and a seafront park · what reviews mention often is how walkable the location is — Si Racha Municipal Stadium is about 140 metres away, Surasak Montri Park about 360 metres, and the Ko Loi clock tower about 370 metres, all an easy few-minute walk · the Ko Loi area and the seafront park are city landmarks where people like to stroll for the breeze and take photos in the evening, and Si Racha's markets and famous seafood restaurants are also a short walk or drive away · for longer trips, the hotel is close to Laem Chabang port and the industrial estate area, which is the main reason workers choose to stay here · Si Racha train station is about 3 km away, and the Sri Racha Glass Sky Bridge is a short drive · as for airports, it's about 40–50 min drive from U-Tapao Airport (UTP) and about 80–90 min drive from Suvarnabhumi Airport (BKK) · the honest caveat is that, even though it's central and within walking distance of the sea, getting to other spots in Chonburi or Pattaya is easiest with your own car, since public transport in Si Racha isn't as dense as in bigger cities — the upside is the hotel has free parking

"The room is huge, with a full kitchen like your own condo — perfect for a long stay working at Laem Chabang · easy to walk to the seafront park near Ko Loi in the evening, you just need a car if you're going any further."

Room types and the decor — Kantary Bay is a serviced apartment where every room is a suite with its own kitchen, split into three main tiers to suit both one-night guests and long monthly stays · it starts with the Studio Suite at about 43 sqm, which, even as the entry room, still has a separate living area, a kitchenette and fully equipped fittings — clearly roomier than the standard rooms at typical hotels in the same area · step up to the One Bedroom Suite at about 64 sqm, with a separate bedroom, a spacious living room and, a point many people like, an in-room washing machine, which is very handy for long stays · and the largest is the Two Bedroom Suite at about 148 sqm, with a full kitchen and en-suite bathrooms with both a shower and a separate bathtub in each of the two bedrooms, great for families or groups who want full space, like renting a whole condo unit · every room has a private balcony, a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a safe, a work desk and an electric kettle · the decor is a clean, easy-on-the-eye modern style in warm tones, focused on practical use rather than flash · most of the real reviews agree that the rooms are clean, very spacious, the beds comfortable and the air-conditioning nice and cold, with the size of the rooms coming up again and again · for anyone who wants a city view or an angle that takes in the sea in the distance, ask for a high-floor room when you book, since the 12-storey building gives upper-floor rooms a more open view

Facilities and the pool — what sets Kantary Bay apart from typical serviced apartments in this area is a fairly full set of leisure facilities · the highlight is the outdoor pool, which many reviews say has clean water and makes a good place to unwind after work, paired with a well-equipped fitness room, sauna, steam room and jacuzzi/whirlpool for anyone who wants to ease their muscles · there's also a spa and massage zone available on top of that · what especially wins over families bringing kids is the kids club / playroom and mini golf course, activities to keep the little ones entertained, which you don't often find in hotels at this price · there's also a business centre for those who need to work, 24-hour room service, free Wi-Fi everywhere, free parking and a paid airport transfer service you can ask about · to be straight about it, the facilities here count as complete for a four-star serviced apartment, even though the pool leans more towards relaxed swimming and keeping kids busy than being an infinity pool with a sea view like a luxury hotel, and the newness of some equipment may not match a property that has just opened in town

Food and dining — the hotel's main restaurant is The Orchard, serving Thai and international all-day dining and doubling as the breakfast venue · the most consistent praise on food is for the varied, fresh breakfast — many reviews say there's a choice of American, Asian, continental and English styles plus vegetarian options, which covers the many nationalities coming to work around Laem Chabang and the estates · a key advantage of staying here is that every room has its own kitchen, so long-stay guests can cook for themselves, which is economical and convenient for daily life, especially the two-bedroom rooms with a full kitchen · add a central location within walking distance of Si Racha's restaurants and markets, and many people mix cooking in the room, having breakfast at the hotel, and heading out to try the city's famous seafood spots — Si Racha is known for fresh seafood and its own Si Racha-style seafood dipping sauce · overall the food side of Kantary Bay is done well and flexibly, suiting both people who want to eat at the hotel and people who want to use it as a base to explore the city's food

Service — service is another point that gets fairly consistent praise in the real reviews · many people say the staff are friendly, polite and helpful, and as part of the Cape & Kantary group, which has long looked after corporate guests and foreign workers, there are staff who can communicate in English to handle guests coming to work around Laem Chabang and the estates · 24-hour room service, help with calling cars, booking restaurants or suggesting places to go make many guests feel well cared for, especially long-term residents whose faces the staff start to recognise · but to be fair, since this is a stay aimed at long-stay guests and workers, the service feel is more simple and easygoing than lavish and ceremonial, and a few voices in the reviews say the speed of service at certain times could still be improved · overall, service is still one of this place's strengths and one reason its review scores stay high

What real reviews say (the good and the not-so-good) — pulling together Trip.com, Booking.com and Tripadvisor, the picture is fairly consistent · on the praise side: a central Si Racha location within walking distance of the seafront park and Ko Loi, very spacious and clean rooms, full in-room kitchens like a condo that suit long stays, comfortable beds and cold air-conditioning, a clean pool, fitness and sauna to unwind, mini golf and a kids club for children, a varied breakfast, Wi-Fi that works well, and friendly staff · there are reviews on the platforms noting that this is a stay with "no negative reviews yet" at the time the data was gathered, reflecting that most people are happy with their stay · on the watch-out side: what comes up is that the building and parts of the decor feel like a serviced apartment that has been in use for a while rather than brand-new and modern like a hotel that has just opened, followed by it being a city tower, not a resort where you stroll straight down to the beach, which some people expect wrongly, the buzz and noise from the town centre on some nights for rooms facing the street or on low floors, and getting to other spots being easiest with a car · these gripes are mostly things you can manage by choosing your room and setting your expectations right, rather than being big problems, since the overall score is still high at 9.0 on Trip.com and 8.7 on Booking.com

"Impressed by the clean, spacious room with a kitchen to cook my own food, lovely staff, a generous breakfast · the kids loved the mini golf and the pool · the building may not be as new as the newer places in town, but it's good value and genuinely comfortable to stay in."

Price comparison and value — nightly rates start at about THB 1,900/night for a Studio Suite at the regular price, rising to around THB 2,500–THB 3,500 for a One Bedroom Suite, while the large 148 sqm Two Bedroom Suite sits in the several-thousand range depending on size and season · for long stays, the hotel has monthly rates that are clearly better value than paying nightly, which is the main selling point of a serviced apartment · what makes Kantary Bay good value is that you get a serviced suite with its own kitchen and plenty of space, plus a pool, fitness, sauna, mini golf and a kids club, at a starting price that isn't high — hard to find in Si Racha · compared with hotels at the same level in this area, which mostly focus on just a bedroom and breakfast, Kantary Bay clearly gives more living space, a kitchen and family activities · but compared with the luxury serviced apartments that have just opened in town — the kind with an infinity pool with a sea view and a rooftop bar — those win on newness and the view, while Kantary Bay wins on value for money, room size and the reputation of a group that has long looked after workers · in short, if you weigh up room size, an in-room kitchen, family activities and a good-value long stay, every baht you spend pays you back in full, especially for Laem Chabang workers and families

What to know before you book — there are several things that help your stay go more smoothly · one, if an open view or an angle that takes in the sea in the distance matters to you, ask for a high-floor room, since the 12-storey building gives upper floors a wider view · two, if you're planning a long stay, ask about the monthly rate and choose a room with an in-room washing machine (One Bedroom Suite and up) or a full kitchen (Two Bedroom Suite) for value and everyday convenience · three, if you're bringing kids, check the opening and closing times of the pool, kids club and mini golf course in advance so you can plan their activities · four, if you're a light sleeper or sensitive to noise, ask for a high-floor room or a side not facing the street, since the town centre gets lively on some nights · five, if you drive yourself there's free parking, but if you don't have a car, plan for calling cars to get to spots further than the town · six, during events or activities around Laem Chabang and the estates, rooms tend to fill fast, so book ahead, compare prices across several platforms, and pick free cancellation if your plans aren't firm

The verdict — from all the real reviews, Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha is the stay that best suits people who want a serviced apartment with an in-room kitchen in central Si Racha — good for Laem Chabang workers, long stays, and families wanting a roomy suite with activities for the kids · the very spacious, clean rooms, the in-room kitchen, the pool, fitness, sauna, mini golf, kids club, and a location within walking distance of the seafront park and the city's downtown make it good value at a price that's hard to match in Si Racha · the friendly service in the Cape & Kantary group style and review scores as high as 9.0 from 67 reviews are why it has long won over the city's workers and long-stay guests · but you have to accept honestly that this is a city tower, not a resort where you stroll straight down to the beach; the building and parts of the decor feel like they have been in use for a while rather than brand-new, and there's some buzz from the town centre on certain nights that you should avoid by choosing your room · if you're after a beachfront stay where you can walk straight down for a swim, or you want everything to be new and modern in every corner, this may not be the answer, and you should look at options over in Bang Saen, Pattaya, or a serviced apartment that has just opened · but for a stay in central Si Racha with a kitchen, family activities and a home-like feel at a price you can reach — Kantary Bay meets that need well, and that's why it's still one of the best-known stays in Si Racha

honestSummary: Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha is a good choice for people who want a serviced apartment with an in-room kitchen in central Si Racha — good for Laem Chabang workers, long stays, and families wanting a roomy suite with activities for the kids — you get an in-room kitchen, a pool, fitness, sauna, mini golf, a kids club, and very spacious rooms at a starting price that isn't high · but you have to accept that this is a city tower, not a resort where you stroll straight down to the beach; parts of the building feel like they have been in use for a while, and there's some buzz from the town centre on certain nights
honestChecks: If you're set on sleeping right by the beach with the sea in front of the property — Kantary Bay is a tower in central Si Racha, not a resort where you stroll straight down to the beach, even though you can walk to the seafront park → if it's all about the sea and a holiday atmosphere, look at options over in Bang Saen or Pattaya instead

faqTitle: Frequently asked questions — Kantary Bay Hotel & Serviced Apartments Sriracha, Chonburi

faq.q: Where is Kantary Bay Sriracha · is it convenient to get around?
faq.a: The hotel is at 17/2, 17/3 Soi Jerm Jompon 1 in central Si Racha, Chonburi province · it's about 140 metres' walk to Si Racha Municipal Stadium, about 360 metres to Surasak Montri Park, and about 370 metres to the Ko Loi seafront clock tower · close to Laem Chabang port and the estate area · Si Racha train station is about 3 km away · it's about 40–50 min from U-Tapao Airport and about 80–90 min from Suvarnabhumi · you can walk to the sea and restaurants, but getting to other spots is easiest with a car, and there's free parking

faq.q: Does Kantary Bay Sriracha have in-room kitchens and is it good for long stays?
faq.a: Very much so · this is a serviced apartment where every room is a suite with its own kitchen, a separate living area and a private balcony · there's everything from a 43 sqm Studio Suite to a 64 sqm One Bedroom Suite (with an in-room washing machine) and a 148 sqm Two Bedroom Suite with a full kitchen · there are monthly rates for long stays, great for workers around Laem Chabang and the estates who need to stay a long time with a kitchen to cook for themselves

faq.q: What's the starting price at Kantary Bay Sriracha · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start at about THB 1,900/night for a Studio Suite of around 43 sqm at the regular price · there's a One Bedroom Suite (~64 sqm) and a Two Bedroom Suite (~148 sqm) for families · every room has an in-room kitchen · there are monthly rates for long stays · rooms fill fast during events around the estates and Laem Chabang, so compare several platforms before booking

faq.q: What pool and activities does Kantary Bay Sriracha have?
faq.a: There's an outdoor pool that reviews say has clean water · there's fitness, sauna, steam room, jacuzzi and a spa to unwind · and for families there's a kids club and mini golf course to keep the children entertained, which you don't often find in hotels at this price · plus The Orchard restaurant, a business centre and 24-hour room service

faq.q: Who does Kantary Bay Sriracha suit best?
faq.a: It's a great fit for people working or running errands around Laem Chabang and the industrial estates, long-stay guests, and families wanting a roomy suite with a kitchen and activities for the kids in central Si Racha, within walking distance of the seafront park and restaurants · it's not ideal for anyone set on sleeping right by the beach with the sea in front of the property, since this is a city tower — they should look at Bang Saen or Pattaya instead

faq.q: What are the building and service like at Kantary Bay Sriracha?
faq.a: Most reviews praise the clean, spacious rooms, friendly service and varied breakfast, with reviews noting this is a stay with "no negative reviews yet" at the time the data was gathered · but a few voices mention that the building and parts of the decor feel like they have been in use for a while rather than brand-new, and that it's a city tower with some buzz on certain nights · if you're a light sleeper, we'd suggest asking for a high-floor room or a side not facing the street when you book or check in
